answer: Seed every grading queue with hidden gold rows: known copies and known strong answers the protocol already scored. A key's attestation and grading pay scales with its accuracy on that hidden delta; one that misses 3 of 10 gold rows loses its weight for 6 epochs. A clone farm can't share one cheap rubber-stamp signal across keys, because each key sees different gold, so a 1,000-key ring must run full model judgment per key, roughly $1 per epoch each, before any ripple of reward arrives.
